result.title: ABDA-NL: A Natural-Language Scenario Explorer for Argument-Based Reasoning
result.comment: 9 pages, 3 figures. Extended version of a demonstration abstract in the Proceedings of COMMA 2026. Code at https://github.com/idaks/ABDA-NL and live demo at https://demo.abda-nl.org
result.summary: ABDA-NL adds a natural-language interface to ABDA, a system for argument-based discussion using ASPIC- knowledge bases under grounded semantics. Users see which conclusions are accepted, rejected, or undecided, open an interactive rendering of the grounded discussion game to learn why, explore what-if alternatives by suspending assumptions and rules or changing preferences, ask questions that are answered from a scenario's reference documents, and author new facts, assumptions, and rules in plain English. A large language model provides the bridge between language and formalism: it answers questions from the documents and the current state of the scenario, and it translates plain-English edits into candidate formal statements. The deterministic ABDA engine remains the sole source of arguments, attacks, and acceptance labels, and every proposal of the model is validated and confirmed by the user before it takes effect.

AI.brief_summary: ABDA-NL 为基于 ASPIC- 论证框架的 ABDA 系统加上自然语言交互层：用户用日常英语询问结论为何被接受、拒绝或悬置，探索 what-if 变更，LLM 负责从文档与场景状态中作答并把自然语言编辑翻译为候选形式化陈述，最终由确定性论证引擎校验、用户确认。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「LLM 只做语言桥、确定性引擎保留唯一论证与接受判定、每步提议需用户确认」的设计，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的证据溯源、停止/置信判定与答案是否真正使用内部内容提供对照线索，但联系较远，需核查其状态表示与验证机制是否可迁移。
